data.revised_prompt:
Create a single horizontal sprite strip for the Codex app digital pet named tracebun in the state running-right, using the attached base pet image as the exact canonical design reference and the attached reference image(s) for pet identity. Use the attached layout guide only as an invisible planning aid for 8 frame count, equal slot spacing, centering, and safe padding; do NOT reproduce any guide pixels, white background, boxes, borders, center marks, labels, divider lines, or layout elements in the final image.

IMPORTANT IDENTITY LOCK: preserve the exact same rabbit pet identity from the canonical base image. Do not redesign the pet. Keep the exact head shape, ear shape, limb shape, face design, markings, palette, outline weight, body proportions, chest badge/prop, and overall silhouette. Preserve the warm brown and cream colors, sturdy chibi body, thick dark outline, tiny service badge on the chest, calm focused eyes, small floppy ears, and reliable engineer energy. Only change pose/action for a rightward running animation. Keep the pet clearly the same individual across all frames.

ANIMATION: 8 separate frames arranged left-to-right in one single row. Each frame shows the rabbit running to the right with a subtle, readable loop. Keep the motion compact and identity-safe: small rhythmic leg and arm movement, slight body bob, tiny ear bounce, and minimal tail/torso shift. The pet should still look like itself in every frame.

OUTPUT / COMPOSITION: one clean sprite strip only, 8 frames in a single row, evenly spaced, centered in each slot, with transparent background or fully non-white empty background. No white guide background, no visible panel lines, no boxes, no borders, no frame dividers, no labels, no text, no watermarks, no extra objects, no shadows outside the character, no layout guide artifacts anywhere. Make the strip suitable for game sprite use.
